deadline.value: January 1 is the deadline to complete an application for full consideration for fall admission.
deadline.quote: January 1 is the deadline to complete an application for full consideration for fall admission (we begin reviewing applications just after that date).

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Statistics subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Pre-application supervisor requirement is not stated.

funding.value: WPI PhD students typically receive funding support through Research and/or Teaching Assistantships and/or Fellowships; applicants should complete applications by priority dates as funding decreases over time.
funding.quote: WPI PhD students typically receive funding support throughout their doctoral studies, through Research and/or Teaching Assistantships and/or Fellowships.

also.quote: With each passing month the availability of funds decreases, so applicants who are interested in funding should complete their applications by the priority dates associated with each term.

entry_route.value: Students entering with a BS complete 90 semester hours, while students entering with an MS complete 60 semester hours.
entry_route.quote: Students entering the program with a BS must successfully complete 90 semester hours of graduate work (students with an MS must complete 60 semester hours).

toefl_min.value: For PhD applicants, minimum TOEFL is 100.
toefl_min.quote: For PhD applicants, a TOEFL minimum score of 100 (internet based) or an IELTS band score of 7.5 is required.

ielts_min.value: For PhD applicants, minimum IELTS is 7.5.
ielts_min.quote: For PhD applicants, a TOEFL minimum score of 100 (internet based) or an IELTS band score of 7.5 is required.
